description: Search cached public x402 sellers by capability. First three matches free; extended results up to12 cost0.01 USDC on Base, no trial. Rank a bounded candidate pool by observed unpaid availability, 402 shape, same-asset atomic price consistency and current matching public Lint metadata risk. Missing evidence stays unknown; scores are not safety, uptime guarantees, identity or proof of paid delivery. No new endpoint request or private monitoring data. Price: 0.01 USDC. Minimal input example: {"capability":"weather forecast","limit":3}. Illustrative output excerpt: {"results":[],"free_top":3,"paid_available":false,"not_charged":true}. Illustrative output excerpt, not a live result, signature, approval or guarantee. Freshness/data/availability checks still apply. How to pay (MCP): Top three cached matches are free; extended results cost the quoted fee only when extra matches exist. No shared trial. Use an x402-capable MCP client. A generic MCP connector without payment support cannot complete a paid continuation. On payment required, STOP. Inspect the exact accepts amount, asset, network and payTo; obtain explicit wallet/budget approval before continuing. Only after approval, let the configured x402 MCP client attach its signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and retry the same tools/call arguments. Never send a separate USDC transfer or paste keys into tool arguments. Never silently fall back from free access to payment. If a signed attempt has an unknown outcome, inspect that authorization/transaction; do not create another automatically.
